newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea June industrial output rise at 17-mth high.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea June industrial output rise at 17-mth high.

text.p: South Korea's industrial output rose 12.4 percent year-on-year in June, the highest rise since January 1996 when it also grew by 12.4 percent, provisional National Statistical Office (NSO) figures showed on Wednesday.
JUN 97 MAY 97 JUN 96
Industrial output +12.4 +6.3 +3.7
Ex-factory shipment +12.3 +7.3 +3.1
Inventories +10.7 +12.1 +20.9
Average factory operation rate 78.4 79.3 78.2
Wholesale/retail sales +3.9 +4.2 +6.4
Domestic machinery orders -0.1 -8.0 +21.0
Imports of machinery -13.5 -13.8 +6.2
Domestic construction orders +48.6 +5.0 +8.9
Note: Figures in year-on-year percentage change. Inventory levels measured at the end of month.
The NSO figures showed the industrial output growth in June was the highest since January 1996 when the growth rate was also 12.4 percent.
The office attributed the high output growth in June to a relatively slow 3.7 percent growth in the same month of 1996 due to labour strikes at several companies.
The industrial output rose by 8.4 percent year-on-year during the first half of this year, up from 8.0 percent growth in the same six-month period of 1996.
Inventories grew by 10.7 percent in June from a year ago, the lowest growth since June 1995 when inventories increased by 6.4 percent year-on-year.
But the office said inventories continued to grow fast in the semiconductor, machinery and automobile industries.
Inventories rose by 41.3 percent in the semiconductor industry, by 32.0 percent in the machinery sector and by 31.5 percent in the automobile industry, the office said.
Shipments for domestic sales rose 6.8 percent year-on-year in June, against a 2.5 percent rise a year earlier, while those for exports rose by 26.8 percent versus a 4.6 percent rise.
Investment continued to slow in June as machinery imports fell 13.5 percent and domestic machinery orders by 0.1 percent from a year ago.
